criteria.contract: Add the adopted integration-proposal scope (Docs/Proposals/GETENROKU_INTEGRATION_V1.md, Docs/Decisions/2026-10-31_GETENROKU_BD_CHANGES.md) to the completion scope of the affected existing items without adding, removing or reweighting any of the 60 items.
Re-rate only the affected items downward or unchanged in proportion to the added scope; record old and new percentages, the added scope and the reason for each item.
Record the total change as an excluded reassessment, never as earned implementation progress; no code, tests or assets change.
Re-freeze the next implementation stage (NPC purpose) on the re-rated baseline before its code exists, keeping its criteria and per-item target increments.
Regenerate the progress view and pass the existing progress and approval-batch checks.
